plan.title: Issue view: one tab set with views, needs-you slot, Discussion, and Details additions (shared view, part 1 of the Stage adoption)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 30 files_scope entries, over the 25-file lint limit: 13 source files in one frontend area (components/issue-detail, issue-view, drawer, PrdViewer), 13 test files, 4 doc files and the CI test list. The issue is already part 1 of a three-issue split (PAN-5244 -> PAN-5253 -> PAN-5246) that the Flywheel runs strictly in sequence because all three edit IssueDetail.tsx and IssueDrawerDetails.tsx; a further split would add a fourth issue to that chain and let two issues edit the same two files at once. PAN-5246 depends on the complete set (tab table, banner slot, Details additions) landing together.

narratives.Problem: The issue drawer and the Stage issue tab (the cockpit) are two different issue views. The cockpit has surfaces the shared view (IssueDetail, drawer density) lacks: Plan with a PRD view, Changes with Files/Checks/Artifacts, Activity with a status history, Discussion, a Decisions tab for Deft issues, a needs-you banner, and Details facts (model, per-agent cost, Ship, linked conversations, stack). Pane-only sessions are invisible in the drawer. PAN-5246 cannot switch the Stage tab to the shared view until the shared view carries all of this.
narratives.Proposal: Follow .pan/drafts/pan-5253.md. One pure tab table (issueTabs.ts: resolveIssueTab, entryClickValue, ISSUE_TAB_VIEWS) maps every tab value either shell accepts to an entry and a view; the tab value is the only state. IssueDetail's drawer branch renders shell-independent tab bodies from a new IssueDetailTabBodies.tsx, a new IssueBannerSlot under the pipeline strip (D-7 first-match rule), and an extended IssueDrawerDetails (container-query columns, Status, model/harness, live duration, pane-only rows, per-agent cost from the cost ledger, cost breakdown, Deft panels, Ship, linked conversations, stack disclosure). The conversation header's branch chip gets a copy button and the strip marks a phase live from a live backend pane. No Stage file, server file, route, contract or store field changes.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No edit to any file under src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Stage/ (IssueMissionControl.tsx included); the Stage issue tab renders exactly as before; deleting the cockpit copies (D-14) is PAN-5246
- No change to the legacy page return or the rail branch of IssueDetail, or to IssueDetailShell.tsx, beyond PAGE_HIDDEN_TABS
- No change to the drawer title row or frame (IssueDrawer.tsx header)
- No change to components/issue-view/inventory.ts, densitySections.ts or tests/unit/dashboard/frontend/issue-view-no-loss.test.ts
- No edit to ConversationPanel, NeedsYouSlot.tsx, IssueActionMenu/*, the SkillOverridesPanel body or the full PickupGateControls variant
- No skill row redesign (PAN-5245)
- No opening of a pane-only session's conversation from the issue view
- No Create PR link, visible next-step line, or shell-specific Details block (PAN-5246)
- No server, route, contract, store-shape or new query-hook change; no new HTTP endpoint
- No merge log and no new status-history data source: Status history is the existing ActivityTab
- No test deleted, skipped or marked .only; no raise of a scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row
- No @container on IssueDetail's root (it would shrink the popover click-away overlay)

autoDecisions.summary: Keep PAN-5253 as one issue and set plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting into sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue is already part 1 of a fixed three-issue sequence (PAN-5244 -> PAN-5253 -> PAN-5246) on the same components; the surface is one frontend area plus tests and docs; splitting would add a fourth serialized issue on the same files.

autoDecisions.summary: Status history maps to the existing ActivityTab; Feed is HappenedFeed above DrawerActivityPanel; Ship has no merge log.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD (D-10, mockup deltas 2, 3, 5) already decided this from the code: no status-history view or merge log exists, and NFR-1 forbids new data sources.

autoDecisions.summary: The no-loss test's new-tab case asserts the entry resolveIssueTab returns and mocks Deft so Decisions is listed.
autoDecisions.rationale: On main the test asserts drawer-tab-<value>, which does not exist for checks/prd/history/code/timeline; this was PRD drift found against post-PAN-5244 main and corrected in the PRD.

autoDecisions.summary: The copied StackDrawer replaces its inline style colours with token classes.
autoDecisions.rationale: The style guide (restated in the PRD) bans inline colours in new code; the cockpit original keeps its own until PAN-5246 deletes it.

autoDecisions.summary: Breakage in IssueDrawer.test.tsx caused by the Details items is fixed in regression-sweep, not in the Details items.
autoDecisions.rationale: IssueDrawer.test.tsx is also edited by the IssueDetail chain; routing all Details-caused fixes to one later item avoids a shared-file conflict between the two parallel chains.
